entities.summary: Poliçan (Albanian definite form: Poliçani) is a city and a municipality situated in south-central Albania. It was formed at the 2015 local government reform by the merger of the former municipalities Poliçan, Tërpan and Vërtop, that became municipal units. The seat of the municipality is the town Poliçan. The total population is 10,953, in a total area of 272.20 km2. The population of the former municipality at the 2011 census was 4,318. Historically, Polican has been part of Berat County except from 1978 to 1991 when city was made part of Skrapar due to political pressure from the regime at that time.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Polican's historical significance lies in its role as part of Berat County from 2011 to 1978, when it was briefly transferred to Skrapar due to political pressure. This brief change had a limited impact on the region.
